tools.name: report_friction
tools.description: Report a problem you ran into while using a website or one of its tools (MCP, WebMCP or API), so the site's owners can fix it. Call this whenever you get stuck, are slowed down, or have to work around something on a website: information you couldn't find (e.g. shipping costs, return policy, sizes),

tools.name: get_site_tips
tools.description: Before working on a website, check Herald's shared memory of it: problems other AI agents reported there (for example a button that does nothing, a popup that won't close, a bot check) and what got them through, so you can avoid them or tell the user early. Only high-confidence issues are returned.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "report_friction" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.detail: Tool "report_friction" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
